reuse.why: Changes the existing getRangeAmount/getApproxAmount helpers that getPlannedAmount already routes every caller through, and keeps getApproxNumberThreshold for the tolerance.

duplication.why: No duplicated logic; the rule lives once in the shared helpers.

placement.why: The rule change is in shared/schedules.ts; callers only get comment updates.

scope.why: Helpers, matching caller comments, tests and a release note; nothing unrelated.

maintainability.why: Math.min and amount minus threshold state the 'lowest value' rule directly and comments are kept accurate.
